title: German Cheese Toast
description: A simple German-inspired snack made with cheesy toast, perfect for a quick bite.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
3. Place the bread on the grill and toast until lightly browned.
4. Flip the bread over and toast the other side.
5. Top the toasted bread with cheese.
6. If using zesty mustard, spread a small amount on top of the cheese.
7. Serve the German cheese toast immediately.
